name: Magikarp
flavorText: A MAGIKARP living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

levelUp.name: Splash
levelUp.description: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

levelUp.name: Tackle
levelUp.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the foe with its whole body.

levelUp.name: Flail
levelUp.description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

tutor.name: Bounce
tutor.description: The user bounces up high, then drops on the foe on the second turn. It may also paralyze the foe.
